title: A week of temperatures
description:
A weather station records one temperature per day, Monday to Sunday, in a `std::array<double, 7>`. Write:

- `double weekAverage(const std::array<double, 7>& temps)`
- `std::string_view hottestDay(const std::array<double, 7>& temps)`: the **name** of the warmest day (`"Monday"` ... `"Sunday"`). If two days tie, the earlier one wins.
- `int daysAbove(const std::array<double, 7>& temps, double limit)`: how many days were warmer than `limit`.

Keep the day names in a second array, so that the index of the warmest reading is also the index of its name.
hints: Keep the names in `constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 7> names{ "Monday", ... };` so `names[i]` is the name of `temps[i]`.
For the hottest day, remember the index of the best so far and replace it only when a reading is strictly greater: that way the earlier day wins a tie.
